summary.text: Teresa Woorman is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 16 who has served since August 12, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Woorman earned a high school diploma from Northwest High School, an associate degree from Montgomery College in 2012, and a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland in 2015.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she immigrated to the United States from Puebla, Mexico, as a child, grew up in Montgomery County Public Schools, and worked for nearly a decade in the Maryland General Assembly before being appointed to the House of Delegates in 2024.
She succeeded Sara Love in the seat.

In the survey, Woorman said she serves as Deputy Majority Whip and as a member of the House Health Committee, and that she has passed legislation on insurance coverage denials, higher-education access for immigrant students and probate system modernization.
She named healthcare, immigration, education and protecting democratic institutions as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
